name: AI Plan Settings
description: Whether the AI guides need a plan.

fields.label: A plan is required to talk to the guides
fields.description: Off: a person who has not taken a plan has the lowest plan's limits, so the guides can be tried while buying is not open. On: they need a plan (or a trial) first.

fields.label: Trial replies, once, before a plan
fields.description: Used only when a plan is required: how many replies a person gets once, with no plan, before they need one. 0 is none.
